## Summary

Describe the problem this pull request solves and the key changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `mvn verify` passes locally for behavior or build changes.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] CI-relevant workflow, Docker, SQL, or configuration changes were checked locally where practical.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, private keys, local configuration, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Protocol and database changes remain backward-compatible where practical, or breaking changes are documented.
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, input validation, rate limiting, logging, or file-handling changes include appropriate tests/review.
- [ ] New dependencies and external actions are justified and use the repository's required pinning/update policy.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing or operational behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Release notes or migration guidance are included when needed.
